intentional_fault.description: High-frequency carrier flap causing BGP route withdrawal

splunk_search_query: search index=idx_network_ops (sourcetype="netspout:snmp:trap" OR sourcetype="netspout:snmp:poll") netspout_run_id="NS-20260929-27d18955" | eval origin_evidence_stage=coalesce(origin_evidence_stage, "RECEIVER_OBSERVED"), current_evidence_stage="SPLUNK_OBSERVED" | table _time netspout_phase sourcetype snmp_pdu_type snmp_request_id snmp_trap_name snmp_oid_name snmp_value snmp_collector origin_evidence_stage current_evidence_stage
splunk_metric_query: | mstats count where index=cisco_mdt_metrics metric_name=* AND netspout_run_id="NS-20260929-27d18955"
